sentences.zh: 还是说你是故意这么做的？

sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，那就是我本来的样子。

sentences.zh: 如果我不是国会议员，我也会这么做，对吧？

sentences.en: I think, you know, as I was talking about, people like us running for office and not changing
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，正如我刚才所说，像我们这样的人竞选公职，而不去改变

sentences.en: who we are, not one thing about who we are, how we act or anything, I think is really critically important.
sentences.zh: 我们是谁，不改变我们的一言一行或任何东西，我认为这真的是至关重要的。

sentences.en: Because when we do lose that part of who we are, who we are in our soul, we start getting disconnected with the people back home.
sentences.zh: 因为当我们失去了那部分自我，失去了我们灵魂中的自我时，我们便开始与家乡的人民失去联系。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you just, you can't really take the girl from Detroit out of me, I think.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我想你真的很难把底特律的烙印从我身上抹去。

sentences.en: Well, let me ask you a question.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我问你一个问题。

sentences.en: And back home in Detroit, MF is like, it's like saying, that guy.
sentences.zh: 在底特律老家，MF就像是，就像是在说“那家伙”。

sentences.en: We're really saying that guy.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上是在说“那家伙”。

sentences.en: But is it, let me ask you what may seem like a kind of a prissy New York Times-y question, but like, but is that, is that befitting a congressperson?
sentences.zh: 但这是，让我问你一个可能听起来有点矫情、像《纽约时报》风格的问题，但是，这，这符合国会议员的身份吗？

sentences.en: I don't know if it's necessarily befitting a congressperson.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否一定符合国会议员的身份。

sentences.en: I think I need to focus on the issue.
sentences.zh: 我认为我需要专注于议题本身。

sentences.en: And I think that for me was a lesson learned of understanding that I was really talking about this incredible historic class of folks that are ready to work.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我来说，这是一个吸取的教训，让我明白我真正想表达的是这群准备好工作的不可思议的历史性人物。

sentences.en: Well, so I do want to understand what the consequences of this are, and I don't want to belabor it, but do you think that in this moment, perhaps unintentionally, you created
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想了解这样做的后果是什么，我不想纠缠这一点，但你认为在这个时刻，也许是无意中，你为你自己，也为更广泛的新议员群体，树立了一个声誉吗？

sentences.en: a reputation, not just momentarily for yourself, but for the broader new freshman class?

sentences.en: No, I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 不，我不这么认为。

sentences.zh: 我能，我，你知道，很高兴今天看到亚历山德里亚·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯在她的办公室前跳舞，就像是，谁在乎你们所有人怎么看我？

sentences.zh: 我就觉得，完全正确。

sentences.en: That's how I feel.
sentences.zh: 我也是这么觉得的。

sentences.zh: 你听到来自民主党领袖比如南希·佩洛西的消息了吗？

sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇你是否听到过她的一些表态。

sentences.en: And I love that she respects that we all are different, and that she doesn't use it to divide us.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴她尊重我们所有人都是不同的，并且她没有用这一点来分裂我们。

sentences.en: So is there any part of you who might be a little proud of this?
sentences.zh: 所以你心里有没有哪怕一点点为此感到自豪？

sentences.zh: 你一开始就说过，你无法把底特律从这个女孩身上赶走。

sentences.en: No, I don't know if proud is not the word.
sentences.zh: 不，我不知道自豪是不是这个词。

sentences.en: It is who I am.
sentences.zh: 这就是我。

sentences.zh: 我想我的最后一个问题是，国会议员女士，现在是特莱布国会议员。

sentences.en: Do you...
I still can't get used to that.

sentences.zh: 习惯它吧。

sentences.zh: 如果我不再是我自己，那就真的无法成为我的选民们所选举的那个人。

sentences.zh: 特莱布宣布，当亲以色列组织“美以公共事务委员会”组织其半年一度的行程时

sentences.en: to Israel for newly elected members of Congress, she will organize her own with a trip to the

sentences.zh: 众议院议长南希·佩洛西赞扬了新议员，称他们为具有变革意义的新届国会议员。

sentences.en: The Daily will continue following the story of Congresswoman Tlaib and this entire incoming class all year.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》将在全年继续关注特莱布女议员和这整届新议员的故事。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: That is why I am here today to break the logjam and provide Congress with a path forward to end the government shutdown and solve the crisis on the southern border.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我今天来到这里，打破僵局，为国会提供一条前进的道路，以结束政府关门并解决南部边境的危机。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, President Trump, for the first time since the shutdown began, publicly offered
sentences.zh: 周末，特朗普总统自政府关门开始以来首次公开提出

sentences.en: the Democrats a way out by giving temporary protection to young undocumented immigrants in exchange for $5.7 billion for a border law.
sentences.zh: 向民主党人提供一条退路，给予年轻无证移民临时保护，以换取57亿美元的边境墙资金。

sentences.en: Number one is three years of legislative relief for 700,000 DACA recipients brought here unlawfully by their parents at a young age, many years ago.
sentences.zh: 第一点是为许多年前由父母非法带到这里的70万“追梦人”计划受益者提供三年的立法救济。

sentences.en: This extension will give them access to work permits, social security numbers, and protection from deportation, most importantly.
sentences.zh: 这项延期将使他们获得工作许可、社会安全号，最重要的是获得免遭驱逐的保护。

sentences.en: In his speech, Trump proposed granting DREAMers three years of legal protection and also restoring
sentences.zh: 在其演讲中，特朗普提议给予“追梦人”三年的法律保护，并恢复

sentences.en: temporary protected status to about 300,000 immigrants from a variety of countries.
sentences.zh: 对来自各个国家的约3万名移民的临时保护身份。

sentences.en: This means that 300,000 immigrants whose protected status is facing expiration will now have three

sentences.en: The offer undermines Trump's own policies since he revoked previous protections for both groups,

sentences.en: It was effectively saying, look, I created a problem by taking away protections for DREAMers.

sentences.zh: 我通过剥夺对难民的保护制造了另一个问题。

sentences.en: Well, that's really not much of an offer, and it wasn't intended to be.
